subject.title: feat(google-meet): retain the full caption transcript per session (#103387)

question: Should Google Meet's full live-caption transcript intentionally retain only the latest 2,000 lines in gateway memory and be lost on gateway restart?
rationale: The patch creates new user-visible durability, eviction, and post-meeting retrieval expectations that correctness tests cannot decide on behalf of product ownership.

options.title: Accept bounded runtime retention
options.body: Land after the cursor repair and live proof, with explicit owner acceptance of restart and eviction loss.

options.title: Require SQLite persistence
options.body: Pause the API and design plugin-owned durable transcript storage and cleanup before exposing full retrieval.

options.title: Defer the transcript API
options.body: Keep the existing recent-caption health surface until maintainers choose a retention contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded runtime retention
recommendation.body: Land after the cursor repair and live proof, with explicit owner acceptance of restart and eviction loss.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and its surrounding Google Meet caption, runtime, tool, and docs paths predominantly originate from this person's focused history.
